title.narrative: SUCOS Suriname Coalition of Sex Workers

description.narrative: Suriname Coalition of Sex Workers is the only sex worker-led organization in Suriname, supporting a diverse range of sex workers, inclusive of trans people, migrant workers, and people living with HIV. Their work is primarily focused on awareness raising and capacity strengthening, including through peer-to-peer learning. They also engage with external parties to establish key partnerships to advance sex workers' rights. They provide key services to sex workers that range from sexual and reproductive health services to meals and assistance with school supplies for their children. The grant will support the following priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries and stipends, organizational development costs, organizational capacity strengthening costs, bank fees, office rent, monitoring and evaluation associated costs, and others; - Meeting/ workshop-related costs such as consultant fees, transportation, meals, materials, and others; - Provision of health services and other services including costs such as medical fees, laboratory testing, personal hygiene items, school materials, and others; - Communications materials for awareness raising and provision.
